Name: Enri0425's Marriage dialogue fix (Obsolete)
Author: Enri0425
Description:
[b]WARNING: This mod is now obsolete, you should use this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44893]one[/url][size=2] made [/size]by himanbam instead, at least until the bug is fixed in a future update of Stardew Valley.[/b]
Have you ever noticed that after one of the latest updates Lewis doesn't give all his speech during the wedding scene?
He just says "(Player name)... You may kiss." instead of "(Player name)... (Spouse name)... As the mayor of mayor of Pelican town, and regional bearer of the matrimonial seal, I now pronounce you husband/wife and husband/wife. You may kiss."
Now, I have no idea if this is intended feature or just a bug. However, since it bothered me SO much, I managed to create a bandaid fix for that.
You need the latest versions of SMAPI  Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Tool to make this mod work.
[s]Included in the download are four folders, which you only need ONE depending on the gender of the farmer and your spouse:[/s]
[list]
[*][s](CP)  Marriage dialogue fix FM (for female farmer and male spouse);[/s][/*]
[*][s](CP)  Marriage dialogue fix MM (for male farmer and male spouse);[/s][/*]
[*][s](CP)  Marriage dialogue fix FF (for female farmer and female spouse);[/s][/*]
[*][s](CP)  Marriage dialogue fix MF (for male farmer and female spouse).[/s][/*]
[/list]3.0 EDIT: You don't have to choose one of the 4 files anymore! Now you can just choose which gender you want your farmer and your spouse to be addressed as with the Generic Mod Config Tool! If you check either or both the MaleSpouse and MaleFarmer boxes they will be addressed as "husband". If you uncheck them, your farmer and/or your spouse will be addressed as "wife".
Special thanks to Nexus user "Blossom5280" for suggesting me the implementation of a config file!
I'm fully aware it's not the best way to tackle this issue, but at least it gets the job done.
WARNING: This mod may be incompatible with others that add new characters. EDIT: 2.0 version now SHOULD be more compatible with other mods.
Also, whenever a new update for SV drops and fixes this issue, this mod will become obsolete and must be deleted from your Mods folder. I will inform you in the comments section when the time comes.
